judgment: It is a little good to hold firm.
image: Heaven, with a mountain under it: Withdrawal.
So the noble one keeps the small person far off —
lines: He is at the tail of the withdrawal: danger.
He holds it fast with yellow oxhide —
But keeping servants and maids: good.

notes.name_en: 遯 is retiring out of reach; 'Withdrawal', not Wilhelm's 'Retreat'.
notes.L6: 肥遯 a plump, unhurried withdrawal — fat kept literal; B adds 'easy', the unhurried sense already in 肥 here.
